description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF7 allies are alive, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
